title: Tactical Operations Summary
text: OPERATIONAL BRIEFING FOR {eventName} AT {stationName}. Expected venue attendance is {attendance} pax with an estimated metro egress share of {metroSharePct}% ({metroPax} passengers). Plan prescribes {gatesOpen} active AFC turnstiles, a target train headway of {headwayMin} minutes, and service extension until {lastTrainTime} (+{lastTrainExtMin} min over baseline timetable).

title: Operational Sequence (T-60 to T+120 min)
text:
• T-60 min: Concourse marshals report to stations; verify {gatesOpen} automated fare gates operational in entry mode.
• T-15 min: Security gate pre-sorting activated; queue switchbacks deployed at stadium concourse.
• T+00 min: Event concludes; station enters post-event ingress mode.
• T+20 min: Primary surge arrival window; verify southbound headway maintained at {headwayMin} min.
• T+45 min: Concourse metering activated if platform density exceeds {meteringLimit} pax/m².
• T+90 min: Secondary surge clearance; transition from express clearing to normal sweep.
• T+120 min: Last scheduled special train clears platform at {lastTrainTime}; station lockup sequence.

title: Staff Deployment & Zone Allocations
text:
Total deployed personnel: {staffRequired} staff members.
• Forecourt & Security Queues: {staffForecourt} marshals directing flow towards turnstiles.
• AFC Gate Line: {staffGates} ticketing staff assisting passengers with QR ticket scanning.
• Platform Edge & Stairs: {staffPlatform} platform screen door safety supervisors preventing surging.

title: Tactical Thresholds & Trigger Rules
text:
1. METERING RULE: If Platform density reaches {meteringLimit} pax/m² (LOS E), Gate Controller must throttle entry gates to 50% throughput for 3-minute intervals.
2. HOLD RULE: If platform holding reaches {criticalLimit} pax/m² (LOS F), immediately initiate Concourse Gate Hold (red line barrier).
3. HEADWAY ESCALATION: If concourse queue spills past outer canopy for > 10 min, dispatch reserve rake from Sabarmati Depot.

title: Public Address & Passenger Guidance Scripts
text:
Concourse Announcement:
"Attention passengers at {stationName}. All entry gates are active. Please keep your QR tickets or Metro cards ready before the turnstile. Trains are operating every {headwayMin} minutes southbound towards APMC."

Platform Safety Announcement:
"Stand behind the yellow safety tactile line. Do not lean on platform screen doors. Please board uniformly along the entire 3-car rake length."
